First, I'll analyze the SVG path coordinates to determine the number of distinct vertices and the shape formed.

The path is:  
M 19.24,16.78  
L 35.66,38.80  
L 35.35,47.96  
L 28.47,55.02  
L 24.85,45.48  
L 14.57,58.70  
L 19.24,16.78  

This means:  
Move to (19.24,16.78)  
Line to (35.66,38.80)  
Line to (35.35,47.96)  
Line to (28.47,55.02)  
Line to (24.85,45.48)  
Line to (14.57,58.70)  
Line to (19.24,16.78)  

Counting the vertices:  
1. (19.24,16.78)  
2. (35.66,38.80)  
3. (35.35,47.96)  
4. (28.47,55.02)  
5. (24.85,45.48)  
6. (14.57,58.70)  
7. (19.24,16.78) — this closes back to the first point  

That gives 7 distinct vertices (the last point is the same as the first to close the shape).  

A polygon with 7 sides is a heptagon.  

Final answer: (B)
